data.narrative: Module 6 traced two contract bugs vertically: cache-first redirects after DELETE, and a worker retry storm that would share the API pool. DELETE already invalidated; a SoT check caught seeded stale cache. Worker isolation, exponential backoff, max retries, and a DLQ were added. BREAK showed delete+recreate doubling clicks 2 to 4 until redirect and dedup keys were namespaced and events purged.
